en.headline: More than 7,500 apply for combined taxi and ride-hailing written test
en.dek: Transport Secretary Mable Chan said the new exam, open since 3 August, has drawn strong interest and that platforms will be invited to apply for licences in the coming weeks.
body: Secretary for Transport and Logistics Mable Chan said on Sunday that more than 7,500 people have applied for the combined taxi and ride-hailing written test since applications opened on 3 August. The first sittings are scheduled from mid-September.

Chan told a television programme that the government will invite ride-hailing platforms to apply for operating licences in the coming weeks. Interest has come from local operators as well as experienced platforms from the mainland and Southeast Asia.

Most of the regulatory provisions for ride-hailing took effect earlier this month. Vehicle and driver permits are expected to open for application in the fourth quarter. The Transport Department is also building a monitoring system that will use operational data from licensed platforms.

zh.headline: 的士及網約車綜合筆試逾7500人報考 未來數周邀平台申請牌照
zh.dek: 運輸及物流局長陳美寶表示，綜合筆試自本月3日開放申請以來已有逾7500人報名，未來數星期會邀請網約車平台申請牌照。
body: 運輸及物流局局長陳美寶周日在電視節目表示，的士及網約車綜合筆試自8月3日接受申請以來，已有超過7500人報名，首批考試將於9月中進行。
她指政府未來數星期會向有意營運的網約車平台發出邀請文件。除本地平台外，亦有內地及東南亞有經驗的平台與當局接觸，希望釐清營運要求。
網約車規管大部分法例已於本月初生效，車輛及司機許可證預計今年第四季開放申請。運輸署正構建平台監管系統，日後會要求持牌平台提供營運數據作動態監管。
